Veerali sets out to uncover the truth behind Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose's mysterious disappearance, joining forces with Anuj, a researcher who has spent 22 years defying the system to expose it. Together, they challenge the official story of Bose's death, revealing he may have lived on, incognito, silently shaping India's freedom.
